seo.intent: Supporting product/capability page — it does not own the primary clinic-software commercial cluster (SEO-KEYWORD-MAP Cluster 1 stays with Product Overview per §D ownership), does not target the patient-record Cluster-4 head, and does not target national e-prescription or electronic-prescription keywords (REJECTED / NOT ALLOWED in the keyword map). The bounded verb pair «ثبت و مدیریت» in the title, H1 framing and copy keeps a searcher expecting a national connection from being invited by mistake; the national term appears only inside explicit negations or a question, never in title, H1, H2s, eyebrows or description. No SEO plugin, no invented search volumes, no ranking claims

product_truth_boundary: PRODUCT-TRUTH §3 #11 (prescriptions/documents — bounded technical evidence; national e-prescription connection forbidden) as the primary ceiling, with #8 (doctor workspace) and #10 (patient records) as the surrounding context, #7 (patient portal — bounded evidence that its scope includes prescriptions and files; exposure of every item is NOT assumed), and #4/#5/#6 (roles, access, clinic data separation) at mechanism level only — all REVERIFY BEFORE PUBLIC LAUNCH. National/Social-Security/Salamat e-prescription integration, automatic prescription transmission, pharmacy/insurance/national health-network integration, drug-interaction checking, AI prescription or diagnosis assistance, regulatory compliance/certification, legal-validity guarantees, mobile app, signing/stamping, file formats/quotas/OCR/cloud storage/external sharing, certification/compliance and absolute security wording are NOT claimed. Text tests are not product capability verification.
